subject.title: macOS: Gateway daemon PATH excludes user bin dirs (nix, bun, local, etc.)

question: Should macOS Gateway LaunchAgents keep the canonical system PATH, expand to Nix/user-bin directories by default, or add an explicit operator-controlled service PATH opt-in?
rationale: This changes daemon command-resolution trust and conflicts with both current hardening docs/tests and current Nix install docs, so automation should not choose the security boundary.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the canonical macOS default, but add a documented and doctor-audited opt-in for Nix/user-bin service PATH entries with regression coverage.

options.title: Expand the default
options.body: Include Nix and common user-bin directories in macOS LaunchAgent PATH by default and document the command-resolution trust change.

options.title: Keep default and fix docs
options.body: Leave the macOS service PATH canonical and update Nix/install guidance to use supported per-exec or wrapper paths instead of promising launchd auto-discovery.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical macOS default, but add a documented and doctor-audited opt-in for Nix/user-bin service PATH entries with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest adjacent owner for daemon service management and security-policy tradeoffs across the implicated files.
